description: Baseline modeled PR CI critical path from current workflow and recent CI timings

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline before small workflow experiments
asi.bottleneck: browser-tests path dominates: build-assets 65.5s + browser matrix 339s + aggregate ~2s
asi.history_source: 6 recent successful pull_request CI runs via gh

description: Try manual browser test filter matrix balanced from CI logs

asi.hypothesis: Manual filter matrix can reduce slow browser shard by balancing heavy Browser test classes
asi.error: autoresearch.sh failed to parse class timings from gh run logs; regex expected escaped backslashes differently
asi.next_action_hint: Fix log parser to match `Tests\Browser\ClassTest` lines, then retry manual filter matrix

description: Balance Browser CI matrix with manual class filters over five shards

asi.hypothesis: Current Pest --shard splits Browser files by count and leaves Transactions alone; manual class groups from CI timings reduce slowest browser shard
asi.observed_effect: Modeled PR critical path drops 50.74s; browser matrix drops 50.74s with same Browser classes covered exactly once
asi.coverage_guard: autoresearch.sh parses recent CI Browser class list and fails if manual filters omit a class
asi.tradeoff: Adds one more browser runner job; wall-clock improves, billed runner minutes may increase slightly

description: Let PR browser shards build assets directly and skip separate build-assets job

asi.hypothesis: On PRs, browser jobs already install PHP and Bun; building assets inside shards removes build-assets dependency from critical path despite adding ~36.6s to each shard
asi.observed_effect: Modeled PR critical path improves another 28.92s versus manual-shard best because 65.5s build-assets gate is removed
asi.correctness: PR still builds assets before Browser tests; push/workflow_dispatch still run build-assets job
asi.tradeoff: More duplicate work across 5 PR browser jobs; faster wall-clock but higher billed minutes

description: Rebalance Browser matrix across six class-filter shards

asi.hypothesis: With asset build moved into shards, reducing max Browser class work matters; six balanced class groups lower max test time from ~162s to ~129s
asi.observed_effect: Modeled PR critical path improves 33.6s over five-shard browser-build setup
asi.coverage_guard: Same 13 Browser classes covered once by explicit filters
asi.tradeoff: One additional PR browser job; wall-clock improves, billed runner minutes increase
